services.body: Vehicles are diagnosed and repaired at the actual fault before anything gets replaced.

reviews.author: Sheridawn Rice
reviews.text: Awful experience. Took my car there for a simple spark plug. Not to mention the spark plugs were cracked!! Put a bad one in and had to turn around and replace right after! And spend more money on top of what I already had to. Not the best customer service either. Don’t recommend! Unless you want more issues! Edit: as soon as I got home my car had to go back into the shop!! They messed with my turbo when they were only suppose to be replacing my coil packs and spark plugs. Lucky I was even able to make it back !

reviews.author: Dominic Artuso
reviews.text: On vacation and was in desperate need to get some brake pads fixed ASAP. The guys here got the parts we needed as soon as possible and got our vehicle fixed very fast. I am so grateful for the immediate help/assistance in a time of need. This company is very trustworthy and holds great standards. If you need help with any car issues, check this shop out. You will not regret it!

reviews.author: Nathan Clements
reviews.text: Tom is the only mechanic in this entire area (lived here 20 plus years) I go out of my way to recommend to people. Always courteous, always honest with you, doesn't talk down to the customer. His service is top notch. Every time I bring my car to his shop, he's very fast, goes out of his way to save you money. I just cant say enough good things about this place. When you're a working man and every dollar counts, having a good mechanic is so important, this guy is an absolute gem.

reviews.author: Lindsey Ridings
reviews.text: We were on vacation and our brake line started leaking and had no brakes, needed it fixed quick. He got us in and made us top priority and got us fixed so we could travel home safely. Great service! Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Ashly Withers
reviews.text: I had an engine light that came on during my roadtrip to SC from Arkansas. Drove my car to third ave repair shop to get it fixed. Not sure what to say but picked up my car and the next day it broke down on the way to Charleston-with the same engine light message and 2 others!. I would give precision tune autocare 5+ stars because after my car broke down hours after it was fixed with third ave, I called precision and when it was towed to their shop, because it wasn't drivable, they fixed what was wrong with it. I mean I had to pay double what I paid third ave the next day, but hey at least I was able to drive my vehicle home. If you are ever in Charleston with car trouble, please visit precision tune auto car for all your auto needs.

reviews.author: Lisa Blackmon
reviews.text: Freddie was great. Was in Myrtle Beach for vacation and my car was making noises on a Friday. Thankfully he was able look at my car and get me in my way. Thank you Freddy!!

reviews.author: Kedrick Mann
reviews.text: Top notch people who have the skills to fix everything. Take all my vehicles there. Locally own business, owner gives back to the community.

reviews.author: ted james
reviews.text: Quoted 8 hr build time and $1800 for oil pump replacement on an 2002 chevy suburban. it being in the front of the engine just under water pump makes it hard to grasps just how this is an 8 hr project..the part is only $115..so what exactly would I be paying for other than your mortage? Not sure what you're smoking but it only takes 2 hrs max and no more than $600..maybe this is why you have a negative 1 review..It's places like yours that make people hate mechanics..You're ripping people off. DO NOT USE THIS BUSINESS Sincerely, A Mechanic of 40 yrs.

reviews.author: Jeff Flowers
reviews.text: Brought my truck in to get looked at and all I can say is WOW! Horrible service and disgusting place. Looks like they are on their last leg! I wouldn’t trust them with a hot wheels car

reviews.author: Marcella Hill
reviews.text: The technician was courteous and professional. He quickly took care of my car and got my family back to our vacation.

reviews.author: Zach Willis
reviews.text: If I could rate 0 stars I would very rude over the phone will never do business with this company. Avoid at all cost.
